{{Quote|No outsider will ''ever'' rule Mandalore!|Bo-Katan, to [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]|<ref name="SoR">{{TCW|Shades of Reason}}</ref>}}
'''Bo-Katan Kryze''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived as a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Amidst the pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Katan pledged her loyalty to the radical Mandalorian splinter group known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], faithfully serving the group's leader [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] as a trusted [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. Ironically, she was also the sister of [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine]], whom the Death Watch sought to usurp multiple times. After Vizsla was killed by Darth Maul, who claimed the title of Mandalore, Bo-Katan led a splinter group of Death Watch loyalists.

==Biography==
{{Quote|There was a time when we weren't enemies.|Duchess Satine Kryze, to Bo-Katan|<ref name="The Lawless" />}}
[[File:BoKatanNightOwls-AFIN.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Bo-Katan, at lower-right, leading the Nite Owls in pursuit of Bonteri and Tano]]
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]], Bo-Katan was the sister of [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] and the leader of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]].<ref name="The Lawless" /> Bo-Katan worked as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] for the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] leader [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="IGN What to Expect">{{WebCite|url=http://uk.ign.com/articles/2011/07/22/comic-con-clone-wars-what-to-expect-in-season-4|text=Comic-Con: Clone Wars - What to Expect in Season 4|archivedate=20161124114916}}</ref> At one point, while on [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]], she met with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-affiliated [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]], who brought along a close acquaintance and fake betrothed, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Katan, suspicious of Tano, immediately commented on how skinny Tano was for someone betrothed (engaged) and thus slapped Tano's backside to make a point of it. After the Padawan and Bonteri turned against them, Katan helped chasing the two, while the other members of Death Watch got rid of the droids who helped the young escapees.<ref name="Death Watch Preview">{{SW|url=video/the-clone-wars-season-4-teaser-death-watch|text=The Clone Wars Season 4 Teaser: Death Watch}}</ref>

===New allies===
{{Quote|We allied ourselves to Sith before. Count Dooku, he betrayed us. Sith are no better than Jedi. They claim to be powerful, but we put these two back together after the Jedi gutted them.|Bo-Katan, towards the idea of the brothers joining them|<ref name="Eminence" />}}
As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] scorched on in the galaxy, Pre Vizsla and Katan found an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] containing the two [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] brothers known as [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] who were knocked out after the [[Skirmish on Florrum/Legends|Skirmish on Florrum]]. Vizsla and Katan later brought the brothers back to their [[Zanbar Death Watch camp/Legends|camp]] on [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]] for repairs. Once Maul had awaken, he showed aggression to the Death Watch members when Katan threatened him by pointing her blaster towards Savage if he tried anything to harm them. The brother and Vizsla later gradually introduced each other then later swapped stories on how they came to where they are. Both Death Watch and the brothers later found that they had a common enemy in [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Vizsla invited Maul for a [[Cassius tea/Legends|tea]] in his tent, where he told Maul the plans of taking over Mandalore. When Maul said it was will of the [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] which made them meet, Katan pointed out her scepticism in allying with the Sith, saying that the Sith brothers are no better than [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who once betrayed them. She also said that the brothers are weak, as they were "put together" by the Death Watch after Kenobi defeated them on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. Maul got angry on hearing it, and started [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force choke|choking]] Katan, saying that they will defeat all the pacifist Mandalorians, Dooku and all other common enemies. After it, he released Katan, who smirked at Vizsla. The Sith brothers later aligned themselves to Death Watch to help them liberate Mandalore from [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]].<ref name="Eminence" />

===Mission to Mustafar===
After pointing out that the Death Watch warriors were not yet ready to takeover Mandalore, Maul suggested enlisting the help of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] who were located at [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] to begin creating an army. Bo-Katan along with the brothers and Vizsla with a strike team scurried to the volcanic planet. After the death of the Black Sun leaders, Maul gave the opportunity to join them to [[Ziton Moj/Legends|Ziton Moj]], who carefully chose to help them embark on their campaign to Mandalore. Shortly after returning to Zanbar, the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] were willing to joined them and help overthrow the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]].<ref name="Eminence" />

===Mission to Nal Hutta===
{{Quote|(Laughing) I see that negotiations have gone as planned.|Bo-Katan, after the attempt to convince the Hutt Grand Council to join them failed|<ref name="Eminence" />}}
After the Pykes joined Darth Maul's [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]], they headed towards [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] to enlist the help of the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]]. After negotiations have failed, [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] pursued the brothers and Vizsla outside where Bo-Katan and her [[Nite Owls/Legends|Nite Owls]] were awaiting the return of them. While Katan and her warriors fought on The Hutt guards, Maul, Vizsla and Savage faced off [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]] and [[Embo/Legends|Embo]]. After the fight had cleared up, the bounty hunters managed to get away safely with minor injuries. The Death Watch warriors were then able to capture a member of the Hutt Council who was left behind known as [[Oruba/Legends|Oruba]]. He was later killed after telling them that the rest left for [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Eminence" />

===Mission to Tatooine===
[[File:DeathWatchElite-Eminence.png|thumb|right|250px|Bo-Katan (2nd from left) with three other Death watch lieutenants in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]]]
Shortly after learning that the Hutts have fled to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on Tatooine, the Brothers and Death Watch launched a small attack to give [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] a last chance to join them. After briefly seeing what the Shadow Collective was capable of and how they performed in action, the Hutts agreed to join them. However, outside the castle Vizsla told Katan to be aware, as they are going to take over Mandalore and they would finish with Maul and Opress.<ref name="Eminence" />

===Takeover of Sundari===
{{Quote|Duchess Satine and the New Mandalorians have fled in cowardice while Death Watch brought these criminals to justice! Your new Prime Minister, Pre Vizsla, leader of Death Watch, exiled Governor of Concordia, true son of Mandalore, presents you with the lords of the most feared crime families in the galaxy!|Bo-Katan, presenting the victory of the capture of the attackers and claiming Vizsla as Mandalore|<ref name="Eminence" />}}
After the Shadow Collective was at its full potential, Maul and Death Watch advised a plan to turn the people of Mandalore to Pre Vizsla that instructed the crime gangsters to [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|attack]] several locations around the New Mandalorian [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], including the [[Sundari shipping docks/Legends|shipping docks]] and the [[Mandalore Banking Center/Legends|Mandalore Banking Center]]. Then, Death Watch would come in and stop the vile thugs and claim Mandalore for themselves in order to gain the trust of the people. After the plan had gone underway, Vizsla alongside Katan approached Satine while she tried to calm the people. After gaining support from the people, Death Watch began to capture the attackers. Katan was tasked on capturing the Black Sun member Ziton Moj who was attacking a civilized area. After fulfilling her assignment, she helped two children out of hiding.

After Death Watch took control of Sundari, they found no more use for Maul and Savage and imprisoned them, with Katan wearing Maul's lightsaber on her belt. After escaping from the [[Royal prison/Legends|Sundari prison]], Maul challenged Vizsla to a duel to the death, which Maul won by subduing and beheading Vizsla with his own weapon, the Darksaber. After witnessing the [[Death/Legends|death]] of her former leader, Katan refused to serve under the clutches of Maul, an outsider, and took a few still-loyal soldiers including her Nite Owls and fought against the traitors. With minor losses Katan managed to escape.<ref name="SoR" />

===Truce with Kenobi===
{{Quote|I don't believe we've met. You are...?''"<br />"''Bo-Katan. I'm here to rescue you. That's all you need to know.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Bo-Katan Kryze|<ref name="The Lawless" />}}
[[File:BoKatan-Kenobi_BattleOfSundari.png|thumb|left|300px|Bo-Katan and Kenobi join forces to fight against the Death Watch.]]
Bo-Katan, along with Satine's nephew [[Korkie Kryze/Legends|Korkie Kryze]] and the Nite Owls, freed Duchess Satine from the imprisonment and led the [[Mandalorian super commando/Legends|Mandalorian super commandos]] on a chase through Sundari. Unfortunately, Satine was soon recaptured, and it was revealed that Maul allowed her to escape so that she would contact Obi-Wan Kenobi for help. As Mandalore was a neutral planet, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] had no jurisdiction so he would be forced to come alone. Bo-Katan watched as Kenobi arrived and rescued Satine from prison yet again, only to be stopped and captured along with her. After Maul killed Satine, she rescued Kenobi as he was being taken to prison, and they and the Nite Owls fought their way to a [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport/Legends|Kom'rk-class fighter/transport]]. Bo-Katan told Kenobi to go to the Republic for help, because, with the Sith involved, it was now a Republic matter. When he mentioned that the Republic would invade, she replied, "Mandalore will survive. We always survive." Kenobi deduced that Satine was Bo-Katan's sister and gave her his condolences before flying away.<ref name="The Lawless" />

==Personality and traits==
Bo-Katan was a confident and brave woman and a fierce warrior. Proud to serve the Death Watch and its goals of restoring the glory of the Mandalorians' past, Katan was steadfast in her loyalty to both the group and it's leader, Pre Vizsla, who in turn trusted Katan to lead and act as an enforcer in his absence.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Her loyalty was shown after the takeover of Sundari, when Vizsla was killed by Maul, she collected the still-loyal members of Death Watch,<ref name="SoR" /> and joined forces with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], in order to gain back what was taken away by the Sith brothers.<ref name="The Lawless" /> Despite being on opposing sides, Katan apparently still loved her sister Satine, and showed sadness when Kenobi expressed his condolences at her death. She believed that the Sith and Jedi were equally bad and that there was no difference between them, though this viewpoint may have changed when Obi-Wan Kenobi sided with her.

Bo-Katan was also able to withstand heavy physical punishment, as shown when she was choked for half a minute by Darth Maul, but when released, she just smirked at Vizsla, after she told Maul straight what she thought about the Sith in general, also showing her plain-spoken personality.<ref name="Eminence" />

As a leader of [[Nite Owls/Legends|Nite Owls]], she always tried to help out the rest of Death Watch, making victory the first goal. She also cared little of danger, which was shown when she bravely took up the fight with the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="Eminence" />

==Skills and abilities==
Bo-Katan was Pre Vizsla's second in command. Her combat skills were beyond many of her fellows, as shown when she fought her former Death Watch allies, dispatching of one on a jetpack within seconds. Katan herself was skilled in flying with a jetpack and used it often.<ref name="The Lawless" />

==Equipment==
[[File:BoKatanDetail-SWE.png|thumb|left|150px|Bo-Katan in full Mandalorian armor]]
Katan wore a set of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] comprising several individual plates [[Color/Legends|colored]] both metallic gray and blue. A pair of circular sigils adorned her [[Armor/Legends|armor's]] shoulder plates. Katan's custom helmet featured a [[Rangefinder/Legends|rangefinder]], and was stood apart from its contemporaries with a more curved and slanted take<ref name="FiN">{{TCW|A Friend in Need}}</ref> on the traditional Mandalorian T-visor.<ref name="TMPac">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref> The unique visor was also outlined with a white trim that, together with the detailing of the surrounding face of the helmet, was reminiscent of a stylized predatory [[Bird/Legends|bird]], likely a reference to her affiliation, the [[Nite Owls/Legends|Nite Owls]].<ref name="FiN" /> Katan's [[Armor/Legends|armor]] was equipped with numerous mounted weapons, including [[Dart shooter|dart launchers]], [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blasters]], and [[Vibroblade/Legends|blades]] encased within her [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]]. She also carried two [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] which she holstered on her armor's thigh plates, and maintained a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] for flight.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Bo-Katan_DaveFiloni.png|thumb|right|150px|Dave Filoni's painting of Bo-Katan with her helmet off.]]
Bo-Katan first appeared in the fourteenth episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]], entitled "[[A Friend in Need]]," though her face was not seen. Bo-Katan's voice was provided by [[Actor/Legends|actress]] [[Katee Sackhoff]].<ref name="USA Today Ackbar">{{WebCite|url=https://usatoday30.usatoday.com/life/television/news/2011-09-08-admiral-ackbar-star-wars-clone-wars_n.htm|text=Admiral Ackbar stars in animated 'Star Wars'|work=[[Wikipedia:USA Today|USA Today]]|archivedate=20190512123539}}</ref> Bo-Katan also returned for the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]]. Although her familial relationship to Satine Kryze was stated in ''The Lawless'', her last name being the same as Satine was not directly stated in the episode itself. It was instead revealed in the trivia gallery for the episode on the official Star Wars website. In addition, initial scripts as well as the book ''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]'' originally intended for Satine and Bo-Katan's relationship to only be indirectly mentioned, although it was later changed to be directly stated in the aired version of the episode.

Bo-Katan was created primarily as a reason to give female fans more opportunities for armored cosplay.<ref name="Pablog">{{SW|url=news/the-quotable-clone-wars-panel-report-from-san-diego-comic-con|text=The Quotable Clone Wars Panel: Report from San Diego Comic-Con}}</ref> The source of Bo-Katan's name and pronunciation is explained by Clone Wars supervising director [[Dave Filoni]] on his Facebook page as being a portmanteau of the names of [[E. Anne Convery|his wife]] and her pet cat. He further describes the pronunciation as sounding similar to [[Wikipedia:Boca Raton, Florida|Boca Raton]].<ref name="Name">{{Facebook|username=dave-filoni|url=notes/dave-filoni/answers-to-your-questions-as-many-as-could-be-that-is/10150751885427571|name=[[Dave Filoni]]|date=January 31, 2012|archivedate=20160304012247}}</ref>

In one of Dave Filoni's paintings of the character, Bo-Katan is shown with her helmet off displaying her shoulder-length red hair.<ref name="Filoni" /><ref name="Name" />
